In this article NVO LLY NVO XLP Follow your favorite stocks CREATE FREE ACCOUNT Eli Lilly has won its first approval to sell its weight-loss drug Foundayo outside the U.S., allowing it to compete with rival Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill in the U.K. It marks only the second GLP-1 weight-loss pill in the European market and comes just two months after Novo launched its Wegovy pill there . The U.K.'s Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency said Monday that orforglipron, sold as Foundayo, will be available for weight management and type 2 diabetes on prescription. As with all new treatments, it will need to be evaluated for cost-effectiveness by the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) to be available through the country's National Health Service. Novo has used its months-long lead in the oral weight-loss space to position Wegovy pill in the market as the most effective oral option for losing weight. Lilly has sought to emphasize that Foundayo can, as a small molecule medicine, be taken without any food restrictions. Wegovy must be taken first thing in the morning with a sip of water and no other food or drink for at least 30 minutes. Foundayo has seen a significantly slower uptake in the U.S. than the Wegovy pill. Lilly CEO David Ricks told CNBC in April this was because it is a completely new medicine that needs time to establish itself with doctors and patients.
